subject.title: fix(control-ui): drop stale Create PR row after merge and surface PR chips mid-turn

question: Should this protected Control UI and gateway behavior change land after a maintainer verifies the intended conservative behavior for real squash-merged and reused branches?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes how Git ancestry and cached GitHub metadata suppress a user action; tests are detailed, but the protected label and absent live UI proof make this an owner decision rather than an automated conclusion.

options.title: Verify and land
options.body: Confirm the real Control UI scenarios and resolve the dependency check, then land the conservative ancestry-based behavior.

options.title: Narrow the behavior
options.body: Keep immediate chip refresh but reduce or revise the merged-baseline suppression rules if maintainers want a less conservative Create PR policy.

options.title: Pause for product diagnostics
options.body: Pause the branch if the desired operator experience for stale refs and reused branches is not yet agreed.

recommendation.title: Verify and land
recommendation.body: Confirm the real Control UI scenarios and resolve the dependency check, then land the conservative ancestry-based behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties steipete directly to the proposed gateway and Control UI behavior; current-main history could not be inspected to identify additional owners.
